PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits Carmen's clue ("She was sitting in a chair in the Rose Garden."). So Carmen (C) must be at row 4, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Suppose Archie were at row 6, column 1: then Douglas would have nowhere left to go. So Archie can't be there. So Archie (A) must be at row 3, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Carmen and Archie crossed out, only one square is left for Douglas that fits his clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a table."). So Douglas (D) must be at row 5, column 6. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Erin that fits her clue ("She was beside the plant in the Greenhouse."). So Erin (E) must be at row 2, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Suppose Bella were at row 1, column 5: then Douglas's clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a table.") could not be true. So Bella can't be there. So Bella (B) must be at row 6, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Virgil. So Virgil (the victim) must be at row 1, column 1. Cross out his row and column. Erin is the only person in the Greenhouse with Virgil, so Erin is the murderer!

CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_1: She was exactly one column west of Douglas.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_2: She was sitting in a chair in the Rose Garden.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_3: Someone else in his area was beside a table.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_4: She was beside the plant in the Greenhouse.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_5: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
